lines.zh: 我背着画箱，走到恶地的红土上
lines.en: I carry my paint box onto the red clay of the badlands

lines.zh: 颜料桶碰着膝盖，一路响
lines.en: The paint pails knock my knee all the way
I look for a spot to stand
The red clay gives the most color here
A few steps, then a look at the light

lines.zh: 画布卷在腋下，不敢松手
lines.en: The canvas is under my arm, I dare not loosen it
The badland slopes are hard and slick

lines.zh: 我眯着眼量远处的岩柱
lines.en: I squint to measure the rock pillars

lines.zh: 我走得小心，怕洒了颜料
lines.en: I walk carefully so the paint does not spill
I have painted this stretch many times

lines.zh: 我停下来，蹲下看土的颜色
lines.en: I stop and crouch to study the color of the soil

lines.zh: 日头太亮，颜色要等一等
lines.en: The sun is too bright, the color must wait

lines.zh: 我把画架扛在肩上，走得不稳
lines.en: I carry the easel on my shoulder, unsteadily
The red clay is loose, each step sinks

lines.zh: 我坐在石头上，摊开画本
lines.en: I sit on a stone and open the sketchbook
The brush moves on the paper, lightly
I look up, then down again
The wind lifts a corner of the paper
The paint is drying, I must dip again

lines.zh: 我一直觉得红色不够用
lines.en: I always find I run short of red
The pillars cast long shadows

lines.zh: 我用拇指抹了一下纸边
lines.en: I rub the edge of the paper with my thumb
The badland sky is very clean
Someone passed, I did not look up
I turn a page in the sketchbook
This one still needs the last stroke
I wipe the brush on the cloth
The red here is still too bright

lines.zh: 你这一站，我的光就偏了。
lines.en: Standing there throws my light off.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，先看你的颜色
lines.en: I look up at you and see your color first
Stand there and do not move, that is perfect

lines.zh: 你身上这种绿，我调不出来
lines.en: I cannot mix that green you are wearing

lines.zh: 我这人看东西，先看明暗
lines.en: The first thing I see is light and shade
Have you come to buy a painting

lines.zh: 你笑一笑，我要那个角度
lines.en: Smile, I want that angle
Hold still, three minutes is all
You look good standing on the red clay
Do not touch my paint box
There are too many colors on you

lines.zh: 这个角度，光落在你肩上
lines.en: At this angle the light falls on your shoulder
I have noted how you look
You may go, I have finished
I still need a back view
Try taking the hat off
The paint spilled everywhere

lines.zh: 我护着画布，手背挨了一下
lines.en: I shielded the canvas and took it on the hand
That threw my lines off

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下红土滑
lines.en: I stepped back, the red clay slipped
My sketchbook fell

lines.zh: 手上全是颜料，看不了伤
lines.en: My hands are all paint, I cannot see the wound
Do not touch me, you will be covered
This painting is as good as ruined
I stood there and caught my breath
You have ruined an afternoon

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，颜色不错
lines.en: The thing in your hand has a nice color
I am not buying, only looking

lines.zh: 这东西拿来作颜料行吗
lines.en: Could this be ground into pigment

lines.zh: 我手上都是颜料，不接东西
lines.en: My hands are covered in paint, I do not take things

lines.zh: 你把它搁下，别挡我取景。
lines.en: Set it down, do not block my view.

lines.zh: 吃的东西，我一会儿再说
lines.en: Food can wait
I could not mix that color

lines.zh: 你身上有别的颜色，比这个好
lines.en: You carry a better color than that
I am not hungry, I am mid-painting
Do not touch my palette
You knocked my paint box
Some paint spilled, a pity
I step back, shielding the canvas first
You stepped on my brush

lines.zh: 这一下，我的画歪了一条线
lines.en: That skewed a line in my painting
My hands are all paint, do not grab them
Step back, I need the light

lines.zh: 恶地上没什么可撞的，偏撞我
lines.en: Nothing to bump into out here, and you chose me
I steadied the easel
Touch it again and the whole piece is ruined

lines.zh: 我这人只跟颜色打交道
lines.en: I deal only with colors
Canvas is easier company than people
Stand there and I will paint you, that is enough

lines.zh: 恶地这么大，我一个人够
lines.en: The badlands are large, I am enough on my own
The paint will not wash off my hands

lines.zh: 别靠过来，你会沾上颜色
lines.en: Do not come close, you will get paint on you
I have painted here three days

lines.zh: 这种话说给画布听更合适
lines.en: Such words suit the canvas better
I do not want to stain you

lines.zh: 你回去的路上小心石缝
lines.en: Mind the cracks on your way back
I pick it up with two fingers
The paint on my hands will smear on it
That is a fine color
I raise it into the light and look
Could this be ground to powder
I put it in the paint box
I pressed a piece into the sketchbook

lines.zh: 掉在红土上，几乎看不见
lines.en: Dropped on the red clay, it is nearly invisible
Whose might this be

lines.zh: 我用指头蹭蹭，看掉色不。
lines.en: A rub of the thumb tells me if it bleeds.
A shadow has entered my picture
I look up and check the light first

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好挡住远处
lines.en: You are standing right in front of the distance

lines.zh: 这一片的光，我盯了很久
lines.en: I have watched this light a long while
I have put the brush down
Few people come to the badlands

lines.zh: 你身上有个颜色，我要用
lines.en: There is a color on you I want to use
The canvas on the easel is still wet
I raise a hand against the sun
Each step of yours changes the light

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，是在画你
lines.en: I keep watching you, I am painting you
You have changed pose twice
The badland light changes quickly
I have put the sketchbook away

lines.zh: 你站得越久，颜色越沉稳
lines.en: The longer you stand, the deeper the color
I mixed a new color

lines.zh: 岩柱的影子移到你脚边
lines.en: The pillar's shadow has reached your feet
A little to the left
This red clay dirties shoes
Let me see your back
I block with the brush
Do not touch my painting
I shove the easel aside
That was the brush handle
You stepped on my palette
Paint has splashed on you
I step back, guarding the canvas
Hurt the painting and we are not finished

lines.zh: 我这拳头也不只是拿笔的
lines.en: This fist does more than hold a brush

lines.zh: 你走吧，我不想毁了这幅
lines.en: Go, I do not want to ruin this piece
I set the easel up on the red clay
There is a new color on the badlands
I lay the paints out one by one
The light here is just right

lines.zh: 我在岩柱下面找了个位置
lines.en: I found a spot beneath the pillars
The canvas is already stretched
I sit and look a while first
A corner of the paper lifted in the wind
This is the third of the day
Canvas up; I mix the red first.

lines.zh: 火燎到画布边，卷了起来
lines.en: Fire caught the canvas edge and it curled

lines.zh: 我从岩柱上滑下来，画箱摔开了
lines.en: I slid off the pillar and the paint box burst open
Water ruined every sheet
The blast flung paint everywhere

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过画布，留下个洞
lines.en: An arrow went through the canvas, leaving a hole

lines.zh: 那股光把颜色都漂白了
lines.en: That light bleached all the colors
I painted all day and forgot to eat

lines.zh: 一道白光，我的画全白了
lines.en: A white flash and my painting went white

lines.zh: 这里没有红土，也没有光
lines.en: No red clay here, and no light
